children: RNS Number : 4509V  Northcoders Group PLC  21 September 2026
Northcoders (AIM:CODE), a leading consultancy and technology training business, will announce its interim results for the six months ended 30 June 2026 on Wednesday, 30 September 2025.
The Company will host a live presentation relating to the Interim Results via Investor Meet Company at 15:00pm that day.

The presentation is open to all existing and potential shareholders. Questions can be submitted pre-event via your Investor Meet Company dashboard up until 29 Sept 2026, 09:00 BST, or at any time during the live presentation.
Investors can sign up to Investor Meet Company for free and add to meet NORTHCODERS GROUP PLC via:
Investors who already follow NORTHCODERS GROUP PLC on the Investor Meet Company platform will automatically be invited.

Northcoders Group plc provides technology talent, training and consultancy services to businesses and individuals across the UK. Founded in 2015, the Group supports organisations in building, developing and deploying high-quality technology capability across Software Engineering, Data Engineering, AI and Machine Learning, Platform Engineering and Quality Engineering.

Through Northcoders, the Group delivers industry-leading technology training and talent development, working with businesses to recruit, train and develop the technology teams they need. The Group’s proprietary NCore technology platform supports its programmes, which combine technical education with practical, industry-led experience.

Through Counter®, the Group provides technology consultancy and teams-as-a-service to blue-chip organisations across the public and private sectors. Counter works alongside customers to solve complex technology challenges, providing experienced technology professionals and high-performing teams across software, data, testing and emerging technologies.

With inclusivity, diversity and quality at its core, Northcoders Group aims to address the UK’s digital skills and capability gap by helping organisations access, develop and deploy the technology talent they need.
Northcoders Group plc was admitted to trading on AIM in July 2021 under the ticker CODE.L. For additional information, please visit investors.northcodersgroup.com.
